triggers.name: new_object
triggers.title: New object
triggers.description: New object in Apttus Intelligent Cloud
triggers.help: Checks for newly created records, e.g. newly created leads, every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes. Each new record will be processed as a single trigger event.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any standard or custom object, e.g. lead

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Fetch new objects created from specified time. Trigger will fetch objects created since an hour if left blank . Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more
